logical_floor.meaning: One walkable logical floor section and one actor/object anchor.

rectangular_bands.meaning: A straight rectangular passage with independently measured length, doorway thickness, and margins within adjoining room walls.

vertical.room_shift_x: top_left_margin - bottom_left_margin; positive values mean the lower room begins farther east

rectangular_bands.centering: A passage is centered only when opposing margins match at both ends; unequal margins are valid offset openings.
rectangular_bands.room_alignment: Margin pairs at the two ends may differ while the corridor remains straight. Different pairs describe shifted room shells, not a corridor bend.
approved_scope: west- and east-offset two-section-wide vertical passages
one- and two-section-wide passages between shifted room shells
rectangular_bands.generalization: Topology accepts arbitrary positive rectangular thickness; exact golden art currently covers thickness 1 and 2.

staggered_paths.meaning: A one-section-thick orthogonal corridor whose upper and lower openings occupy different wall positions.
staggered_paths.direction: Derived from the sign of bottom_x - top_x.
staggered_paths.path: Upper vertical stem, one horizontal bend row, and lower vertical stem.
staggered_paths.status: approved for eastward and westward dogleg fixtures

integration_map.connectivity: One cardinally connected organic dungeon with northern chambers, a central junction complex, looping side wings, and a staggered southern route.
integration_map.elevation: Intentionally absent from the approved pre-elevation target.

elevation.primary_model: sunken rooms and pathways cut into an explicit higher terrain plane
elevation.surface_occupancy: Every rendered terrain surface is explicit and separate from walkability.
elevation.height_data: Every surface cell has an explicit non-negative elevation; blank ASCII space has no elevation meaning.
elevation.walkability: Walkable cells are a separate subset of terrain surfaces.
elevation.cliff_detection: A directed cliff edge exists only between two defined cardinally adjacent surfaces where the first is higher than the second.
elevation.crop_boundary: A missing neighbor produces no implicit cliff or closing wall, allowing the upper plane to continue beyond a review crop.
elevation.face_direction: Cliff faces descend toward the lower adjacent surface.

lattice.meaning: A shared interior intersection surrounded by four occupied floor sections.

east_cap.rule: An underside terminating into an east-wall face reserves one recessed blank column before the face slash.

open_work: Render and manually review the first sunken corridor and chamber cliff artwork.
Add inside and outside cliff corners.
Add a sunken junction surrounded by elevated terrain.
Apply the approved terrain-cut treatment to the organic dungeon.
Manually review actors, visibility modes, freestanding platforms, and multiple levels.
